title: The girl at fifteen, the end stool
logline: Gully's daughter on the end stool at fifteen with a coffee she's allowed now, from behind, and this time Gully at the grill with his back to her. Two years after the first time. The page draws what's been allowed.

panels.composition: A fifteen-year-old girl from behind on a shop's end stool with a coffee, a heavy gray man's back at the grill, the corkboard above, morning.

characters.pose: fifteen, on the end stool, from behind
